|---|---|---|---|

| Token | Replay or a stale link | Expires after 30 minutes. Single use, marked used in the same transaction as the password update. | §11 |
| `POST /reset-password` | Weak password, brute-forcing tokens | Reuse the existing 12-character rule. Rate limit. Generic `400` for any invalid, expired or used token. | §11 |
